=================== Update_FillerContacts_EmployeesAndUsers_20261022.sql (179 lines)
/*
    Update: filler email addresses and mobile numbers for employees and users (test / demo databases)
    Date: 2026-10-22
    WHAT IT DOES
      Fills a contact value ONLY where it is empty. A real email or mobile number is never overwritten.
        * Employees (active): a missing Email becomes   <employee code>@example.com   (e.g. emp0000277@example.com)
                              a missing MobileNo becomes 1000000000 + EmployeeMasterID  (e.g. 1000000492)
        * Users: a missing Email / Mobile is taken from the user's own employee (the REAL value if the employee has one,
          otherwise the same filler the employee gets), so a user and the employee behind the login always agree.
          A user with no employee gets   user<UserMasterID>@example.com   and   1100000000 + UserMasterID.
    WHY THESE VALUES ARE SAFE
      * example.com is reserved for documentation (RFC 2606): nobody can register it, so mail to it can never reach a person.
      * The filler mobile numbers start 10... / 11..., a range Indian mobile numbering does not assign (mobiles start 6-9), so a
        WhatsApp message to one is rejected by the provider instead of reaching a stranger. They are still exactly 10 digits, so the
        employee form (which wants 10 digits) accepts them.
      Menu Publish sends WhatsApp to every active employee with the canteen on and a mobile number; mail goes out through the
      configured mail provider. A filler value therefore shows up as a failed send in the logs, never as a message to a real person.
      (A REAL number that is already on an employee still receives messages - this script does not change that.)
    NOTES
      * HR_EmployeeMaster is shared with the payroll system: only Email and MobileNo are written, and only where empty.
      * The employee audit trail (HR_EmployeeMasterAuditLog) and EditUserMasterId / EditUserDateTime are not touched.
      * Re-running it changes nothing more (it only fills what is still empty).
    HOW TO USE
      1. Run it as it is: it changes nothing. It shows a summary, the users with the employee behind each login, and sample rows.
      2. Check them, then set @Apply = 1 and run it again.
    SQL Server 2014 compatible.
=================== Update_CanteenEmployees_ActiveLoginMapping_20261022.sql (137 lines)
/*
    Update: Canteen facility + meal plan for active employees who have an active login
    Date: 2026-10-22
    WHAT THIS IS FOR
      An employee only takes part in the canteen when HR_EmployeeMaster.IsCanteenFacility = 1, and the meal plan
      (HR_EmployeeMaster.CanteenFacilityType = 'Daily' or 'Adhoc') decides which meal-session rate they are charged.
      Menu Publish notifies exactly the employees who are Status = 1 AND IsCanteenFacility = 1, and the meal-rate lookup
      (api/MealSession/GetEmployeeMealRates/{employeeMasterId}) refuses an employee whose canteen facility is off.
      A login only reaches its employee through HR_UserMaster.EmployeeMasterID. So this script sets up the people who can
      actually sign in and see the sessions: active employees that are mapped to an ACTIVE user.
    WHAT IT CHANGES (only these two columns of HR_EmployeeMaster, nothing else on the employee):
      * canteen facility OFF                         -> turned ON, with the meal plan below (an existing valid plan is kept)
      * canteen facility ON but meal plan missing    -> meal plan set to the plan below
      * canteen facility ON with a valid plan        -> left alone (an Adhoc employee is never switched to Daily)
      Employees with no active login are never touched; they are only listed so you can see who is missing.
    HOW TO USE
      1. Run it as it is. It changes nothing: it shows a summary, then the employees it WOULD change, then the active
         employees that have no active login.
      2. Adjust the settings below if needed (one company only, the default plan, only people reachable by email / mobile).
      3. When the list is right, set @Apply = 1 and run it again.
    Run Migration_CanteenDailyAdhocRates_20261016.sql first (it adds CanteenFacilityType). Safe to run more than once.
    The application's own employee audit trail (HR_EmployeeMasterAuditLog) is not written by a script like this, and
    EditUserMasterId / EditUserDateTime on the employee are left as they are. SQL Server 2014 compatible.
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON;
=================== Update_CanteenMealSession_Rates_20261022.sql (169 lines)
/*
    Update: Canteen meal session rates - Daily and Adhoc
    Date: 2026-10-22
    HOW THE RATES WORK
      Every meal session (Breakfast, Lunch ...) carries TWO rates, each split into a company part and an employee part:
        Daily  rate   CompanyShare      + EmployeeShare        for employees whose Meal Plan is "Daily Meal"
        Adhoc  rate   AdhocCompanyShare + AdhocEmployeeShare   for employees whose Meal Plan is "Adhoc Meal"
      The employee's plan lives on HR_EmployeeMaster.CanteenFacilityType; the application picks the matching pair
      (GET api/MealSession/GetEmployeeMealRates/{employeeMasterId}).
      Migration_CanteenDailyAdhocRates_20261016.sql copied each session's Daily shares into its Adhoc shares, so right now
      Daily = Adhoc everywhere. This script is how you give the Adhoc plan its own rate.
    HOW TO USE
      1. Run it as it is. It changes nothing: it lists every meal session with its current and new rates.
      2. Fill in your rates in the EDIT HERE block (one UPDATE line per session). A column left out stays as it is.
      3. Run it again and check the "new" columns, then set @Apply = 1 and run it a last time to save.
    IF THE ADHOC RATES ARE ALL 0
      Rows loaded later (e.g. DbMigrator/deploy/module_data/01_canteen.sql, which only carries CompanyShare / EmployeeShare) get 0 in
      the Adhoc columns, because the migration's copy of Daily into Adhoc only ran once, when the columns were added. Set
      @CopyDailyToAdhocWhereZero = 1 to give every session whose Adhoc rate is 0 + 0 the same rate as its Daily one (what the
      migration intended: nothing changes for anyone until HR edits the Adhoc rate). A rate you type below always wins.
    Run Migration_CanteenDailyAdhocRates_20261016.sql first (it adds the Adhoc columns). Safe to run more than once.
    SQL Server 2014 compatible.
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON;

=================== Update_FillerContacts_EmployeesAndUsers_20261022.sql (179 lines)
/*
    Update: filler email addresses and mobile numbers for employees and users (test / demo databases)
    Date: 2026-10-22
    WHAT IT DOES
      Fills a contact value ONLY where it is empty. A real email or mobile number is never overwritten.
        * Employees (active): a missing Email becomes   <employee code>@example.com   (e.g. emp0000277@example.com)
                              a missing MobileNo becomes 1000000000 + EmployeeMasterID  (e.g. 1000000492)
        * Users: a missing Email / Mobile is taken from the user's own employee (the REAL value if the employee has one,
          otherwise the same filler the employee gets), so a user and the employee behind the login always agree.
          A user with no employee gets   user<UserMasterID>@example.com   and   1100000000 + UserMasterID.
    WHY THESE VALUES ARE SAFE
      * example.com is reserved for documentation (RFC 2606): nobody can register it, so mail to it can never reach a person.
      * The filler mobile numbers start 10... / 11..., a range Indian mobile numbering does not assign (mobiles start 6-9), so a
        WhatsApp message to one is rejected by the provider instead of reaching a stranger. They are still exactly 10 digits, so the
        employee form (which wants 10 digits) accepts them.
      Menu Publish sends WhatsApp to every active employee with the canteen on and a mobile number; mail goes out through the
      configured mail provider. A filler value therefore shows up as a failed send in the logs, never as a message to a real person.
      (A REAL number that is already on an employee still receives messages - this script does not change that.)
    NOTES
      * HR_EmployeeMaster is shared with the payroll system: only Email and MobileNo are written, and only where empty.
      * The employee audit trail (HR_EmployeeMasterAuditLog) and EditUserMasterId / EditUserDateTime are not touched.
      * Re-running it changes nothing more (it only fills what is still empty).
    HOW TO USE
      1. Run it as it is: it changes nothing. It shows a summary, the users with the employee behind each login, and sample rows.
      2. Check them, then set @Apply = 1 and run it again.
    SQL Server 2014 compatible.
=================== Update_CanteenEmployees_ActiveLoginMapping_20261022.sql (137 lines)
/*
    Update: Canteen facility + meal plan for active employees who have an active login
    Date: 2026-10-22
    WHAT THIS IS FOR
      An employee only takes part in the canteen when HR_EmployeeMaster.IsCanteenFacility = 1, and the meal plan
      (HR_EmployeeMaster.CanteenFacilityType = 'Daily' or 'Adhoc') decides which meal-session rate they are charged.
      Menu Publish notifies exactly the employees who are Status = 1 AND IsCanteenFacility = 1, and the meal-rate lookup
      (api/MealSession/GetEmployeeMealRates/{employeeMasterId}) refuses an employee whose canteen facility is off.
      A login only reaches its employee through HR_UserMaster.EmployeeMasterID. So this script sets up the people who can
      actually sign in and see the sessions: active employees that are mapped to an ACTIVE user.
    WHAT IT CHANGES (only these two columns of HR_EmployeeMaster, nothing else on the employee):
      * canteen facility OFF                         -> turned ON, with the meal plan below (an existing valid plan is kept)
      * canteen facility ON but meal plan missing    -> meal plan set to the plan below
      * canteen facility ON with a valid plan        -> left alone (an Adhoc employee is never switched to Daily)
      Employees with no active login are never touched; they are only listed so you can see who is missing.
    HOW TO USE
      1. Run it as it is. It changes nothing: it shows a summary, then the employees it WOULD change, then the active
         employees that have no active login.
      2. Adjust the settings below if needed (one company only, the default plan, only people reachable by email / mobile).
      3. When the list is right, set @Apply = 1 and run it again.
    Run Migration_CanteenDailyAdhocRates_20261016.sql first (it adds CanteenFacilityType). Safe to run more than once.
    The application's own employee audit trail (HR_EmployeeMasterAuditLog) is not written by a script like this, and
    EditUserMasterId / EditUserDateTime on the employee are left as they are. SQL Server 2014 compatible.
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON;
=================== Update_CanteenMealSession_Rates_20261022.sql (169 lines)
/*
    Update: Canteen meal session rates - Daily and Adhoc
    Date: 2026-10-22
    HOW THE RATES WORK
      Every meal session (Breakfast, Lunch ...) carries TWO rates, each split into a company part and an employee part:
        Daily  rate   CompanyShare      + EmployeeShare        for employees whose Meal Plan is "Daily Meal"
        Adhoc  rate   AdhocCompanyShare + AdhocEmployeeShare   for employees whose Meal Plan is "Adhoc Meal"
      The employee's plan lives on HR_EmployeeMaster.CanteenFacilityType; the application picks the matching pair
      (GET api/MealSession/GetEmployeeMealRates/{employeeMasterId}).
      Migration_CanteenDailyAdhocRates_20261016.sql copied each session's Daily shares into its Adhoc shares, so right now
      Daily = Adhoc everywhere. This script is how you give the Adhoc plan its own rate.
    HOW TO USE
      1. Run it as it is. It changes nothing: it lists every meal session with its current and new rates.
      2. Fill in your rates in the EDIT HERE block (one UPDATE line per session). A column left out stays as it is.
      3. Run it again and check the "new" columns, then set @Apply = 1 and run it a last time to save.
    IF THE ADHOC RATES ARE ALL 0
      Rows loaded later (e.g. DbMigrator/deploy/module_data/01_canteen.sql, which only carries CompanyShare / EmployeeShare) get 0 in
      the Adhoc columns, because the migration's copy of Daily into Adhoc only ran once, when the columns were added. Set
      @CopyDailyToAdhocWhereZero = 1 to give every session whose Adhoc rate is 0 + 0 the same rate as its Daily one (what the
      migration intended: nothing changes for anyone until HR edits the Adhoc rate). A rate you type below always wins.
    Run Migration_CanteenDailyAdhocRates_20261016.sql first (it adds the Adhoc columns). Safe to run more than once.
    SQL Server 2014 compatible.
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON;

=================== Migration_CanteenMealBooking_20261023.sql (202 lines)
/*
    Canteen: Meal Booking (mobile app)
    Date   : 2026-10-23
    WHAT IT ADDS
      Part 1 - HR_CMS_MealBooking: one row per employee + meal date + meal session. The price
               (EmployeeShare / CompanyShare) and the Daily/Adhoc type are copied from the employee's
               Meal Plan and the Meal Session when the meal is booked, so a later rate change never
               changes a meal already booked. Cancelling sets Status = 'Cancelled' - rows are never
               deleted.
               UX_HR_CMS_MealBooking_ActiveMeal is the "never book the same meal twice for the same day"
               rule: only one 'Booked' row per employee / date / session. A cancelled meal can be booked
               again.
      Part 2 - RBAC. A "Meal Booking" row in HR_MenuItems (/canteen-management/meal-booking) and the
               rights the API checks:
                   GET  api/MealBooking/GetMyBookings -> VIEW
                   POST api/MealBooking/BookMeals     -> CREATE
                   POST api/MealBooking/CancelMeals   -> DELETE
               The route has no Angular screen, so the sidebar never shows it (it is not in the
               front-end's IMPLEMENTED_ROUTES); it only exists to carry the permission.
      Part 3 - Grants those rights to:
                 a) every role listed in @RoleCodes (edit the list - put the role your employees have), and
                 b) when @GrantToCanteenEmployees = 1, directly (HR_UserScreenAccess) to every active login
                    whose employee has Canteen Facility ticked. Employees given Canteen Facility later
                    need a role from (a), or access given from Admin > RBAC.
    ROLL-OUT ORDER
      Run BEFORE deploying the code. Permissions are cached for 5 minutes, so logged-in users pick up
      the new rights within 5 minutes - no re-login needed.
    Idempotent - safe to run more than once.
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
=================== Migration_CanteenConfig_20261023.sql (77 lines)
/*
    Canteen: module settings table
    Date   : 2026-10-23
    WHAT IT ADDS
      HR_CMS_Config - the canteen module's own settings, one row for the whole installation (the row is
      pinned to ConfigId = 1 by a CHECK constraint, so there can never be a second one to disagree with
      the first). It starts with a single setting:
        MaxOrderCutoffDaysBefore   how far back the Meal Session screen lets an ordering deadline be set.
                                   1 (the default) = the deadline may fall on the day of the meal or the
                                   day before. 2 = also two days before, and so on up to 7.
      This is NOT when ordering closes - that is per meal session (HR_CMS_MealSession.OrderCutoffTime /
      OrderCutoffDaysBefore, set on the Meal Session screen). This is only how many choices that screen's
      "Cutoff Day" list offers. It lives here rather than in appsettings.json so it can be changed without
      touching a config file or restarting the API: the screen reads this row every time it is opened.
    HOW TO CHANGE IT
      Let the kitchen be told up to three days ahead:
        UPDATE dbo.HR_CMS_Config
           SET MaxOrderCutoffDaysBefore = 3, ModifiedDate = GETDATE(), ModifiedById = 1
         WHERE ConfigId = 1;
      Anyone on the Meal Session screen sees the longer list the next time they open it - no deploy, no
      restart. Lowering it again never invalidates a meal session already saved with a longer notice:
      that session keeps its deadline and still saves, it just cannot be moved further back.
      0 to 7 only - CK_HR_CMS_MealSession_OrderCutoffDaysBefore will not store a deadline beyond 7 days.
    Run BEFORE deploying the code. Idempotent - safe to run more than once.
    SQL Server 2014 compatible.
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON;
=================== Migration_CanteenMealSessionOrderCutoff_20261023.sql (113 lines)
/*
    Canteen: per-meal ordering deadline
    Date   : 2026-10-23
    WHAT IT ADDS
      HR_CMS_MealSession gets the deadline by which a meal has to be ordered:
        OrderCutoffTime       TIME - the clock time ordering closes
        OrderCutoffDaysBefore INT  - 0 = that same clock time on the day of the meal,
                                     1 = the day before, 2 = two days before ...
      Breakfast ordered "up to 11:59 PM the night before" is 23:59 + 1. Lunch ordered "by 9:30 in the
      morning" is 09:30 + 0. Both columns are NOT NULL: every meal session carries its own deadline,
      there is no "not configured" state.
    WHAT IT REPLACES
      Until now the deadline was appsettings.json MealBooking.BookingCloseHours (every meal closed
      2 hours before it started) and MealBooking.CancelCutoffHours (24 hours to cancel). Both settings
      are gone from the code: ordering AND cancelling now stop at the session's own cutoff.
      Existing rows are backfilled with StartTime minus 2 hours - the rule that was in force - so on the
      day this is deployed nothing changes for any employee. Set the real deadlines afterwards with
      Update_CanteenMealSession_OrderCutoff_20261023.sql, or on the Meal Session screen.
    THE TWO RULES THE CHECK CONSTRAINTS KEEP
      - 0 to 7 days before, nothing else. The Meal Session screen offers fewer than that by default:
        HR_CMS_Config.MaxOrderCutoffDaysBefore (default 1 = same day or the day before), added by
        Migration_CanteenConfig_20261023.sql. Raise that row to open up more days, up to the 7 allowed here.
      - A same-day cutoff can never be after the meal starts. Breakfast served 07:30-09:30 cannot be
        ordered at 08:00 on the day; the cutoff has to be 07:30 or earlier, or move to a day before.
    Run BEFORE deploying the code. Idempotent - safe to run more than once.
    SQL Server 2014 compatible.
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON;
IF OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[HR_CMS_MealSession]', N'U') IS NULL
=================== Update_CanteenMealSession_OrderCutoff_20261023.sql (178 lines)
/*
    Update: Canteen meal session ordering deadlines
    Date: 2026-10-23
    HOW THE DEADLINE WORKS
      Every meal session carries the moment ordering closes, as a clock time plus how many days before
      the meal that clock time falls on:
        OrderCutoffTime       the clock time ordering closes
        OrderCutoffDaysBefore 0 = that time on the day of the meal, 1 = the day before, 2 = two days before ...
      So "Breakfast has to be asked for by 11:59 PM the night before" is 23:59 + 1, and "Lunch by 9:30 in
      the morning" is 09:30 + 0. The same deadline governs cancelling: after it passes the count is final,
      the employee can neither add nor drop that meal.
    HOW TO USE
      1. Run it as it is. It changes nothing: it lists every meal session with its current and new deadline.
      2. Fill in your deadlines in the EDIT HERE block (one UPDATE line per session). A column left out stays
         as it is.
      3. Run it again and check the "new" columns, then set @Apply = 1 and run it a last time to save.
    WHAT IT WILL REFUSE
      - A same-day deadline (DaysBefore = 0) later than the meal's own start time. Breakfast served
        07:30-09:30 cannot be ordered at 08:00 on the day: use 07:30 or earlier, or set DaysBefore = 1.
      - Fewer than 0 or more than 7 days before.
      A deadline further back than HR_CMS_Config.MaxOrderCutoffDaysBefore (default 1) saves fine here and
      keeps working, but cannot be moved further back from the Meal Session screen until that row is raised.
    Run Migration_CanteenMealSessionOrderCutoff_20261023.sql first (it adds the columns).
    Safe to run more than once. SQL Server 2014 compatible.
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON;
DECLARE @Apply        BIT    = 0;   -- 0 = preview only (default), 1 = save the changes
DECLARE @ModifiedById BIGINT = 1;   -- written to HR_CMS_MealSession.ModifiedById
=================== Migration_SalaryHeadCtcSection_20261023.sql (114 lines)
/*
    Migration: salary head CTC Section + its Lookup Master wording
    Date: 2026-10-23
    Run against the HRMSystem database BEFORE deploying the corresponding code.
    The CTC Structure (Annexure-I) work was ported from SolutionOneWeb, where the column is created by
    App_Data/DbMigrations/239_SalaryHeadCtcSection.sql and the wording seeded by 240_CtcSectionLookup.sql.
    Those scripts run against the payroll database only, so an HRMSystem database never received them and
    every query over HR_SalaryHeadMaster fails with "Invalid column name 'CTCSection'" - the entity maps
    CtcSection to that column, so even GetAllSalaryHeadMasters selects it. This script is those two, merged.
    A head's Add / Deduct cannot say where it belongs on the sheet: employer contributions are stored as
    Deduct (or None) yet belong to C, and bonus / gratuity have no Add / Deduct at all. So each head gets
    a CTC Section:
        NULL = automatic: Add -> A, Deduct -> E, anything else not shown
        A Gross salary   B Other payments / benefits   C Other cost to company
        E Deductions     R Retention benefit           X never shown
    Only heads whose NAME plainly says where they belong are pre-set, so a client's own heads keep the
    Add / Deduct placement until someone picks a section. The section's wording is data, kept as the
    lookup list "CTCSection" and seeded per company only for a code that company does not have yet.
    Purely additive and idempotent: safe to re-run.
*/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
IF OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[HR_SalaryHeadMaster]', N'U') IS NOT NULL
   AND COL_LENGTH(N'[dbo].[HR_SalaryHeadMaster]', 'CTCSection') IS NULL
BEGIN

import re
out='Deployment_Since19Oct_20261023.sql'

header = r"""/*
    DEPLOYMENT - everything since Deployment_ApprovalAndRecruitment_20261019.sql
    Date: 2026-10-23
    Run Deployment_ApprovalAndRecruitment_20261019.sql first (or confirm it already ran). This script carries
    on from it: Mobile Attendance, salary head CTC Section, Canteen meal booking / ordering deadlines / settings,
    the F&F setup, and today's one-off data fixes.

    HOW TO RUN
        sqlcmd -S <server> -U <user> -d <database> -C -I -i Deployment_Since19Oct_20261023.sql
        (or open it in SSMS and execute). Do NOT pass -b: every section stands alone, and a section that
        stops (e.g. "ABORTED - missing base tables") must not stop the ones after it.
    Run it BEFORE deploying the matching application build, ideally on a copy of the database first,
    then read the Messages tab: every section prints a "=== n ..." banner followed by what it did.

    PART A - schema (always runs, idempotent: each change checks whether it is already there)
      A1  Mobile attendance tables                                   [Migration_MobileAttendance_20261021]
      A2  HR_SalaryHeadMaster.CTCSection + "CTCSection" lookup list   [Migration_SalaryHeadCtcSection_20261023]
      A3  Canteen settings table HR_CMS_Config                        [Migration_CanteenConfig_20261023]
      A4  Canteen per-meal ordering deadline (+ backfill)             [Migration_CanteenMealSessionOrderCutoff_20261023]
      A5  Canteen meal booking table + RBAC rights                    [Migration_CanteenMealBooking_20261023]
            -> EDIT HERE inside A5: @RoleCodes (default 'ADMIN') = the roles your employees log in with.
      A6  F&F approval form doc ("FNF Approval")                      [Migration_FnfApprovalFormDoc_20260930]
      A7  F&F exit clearance departments                              [Migration_FnfClearanceDepartmentConfig_20260930]
            A6/A7 were already in the 19 Oct deployment - repeated here so this script alone leaves F&F
            complete; on a database that has them they change nothing. The F&F code changes of 23 Oct
            (recovery department drop-down, click-to-edit grids) needed no schema change.

    PART B - one-off data fixes. Each is OFF by default: with its switch at 0 it only PREVIEWS (shows what it
    would change, then rolls back). Read the preview, set the switch to 1, run again.
      B1  Merge duplicate departments / designations                  [Cleanup_DuplicateDepartmentsDesignations_20261023]
      B2  Canteen facility + meal plan for employees with a login     [Update_CanteenEmployees_ActiveLoginMapping_20261022]
      B3  Remove the 3 duplicate Travel form docs (dev DB only;       [Delete_DuplicateTravelFormDocs_20261022]
          refuses unless exactly those 3 rows qualify)

    NOT INCLUDED - run on their own when needed
      Update_CanteenMealSession_Rates_20261022.sql        needs your Adhoc rates typed in per meal session
      Update_CanteenMealSession_OrderCutoff_20261023.sql  needs your real ordering deadlines per meal session
                                                          (A4 backfills "start time minus 2 hours" meanwhile)
      Seed_MobileAppTestData_20261021.sql                 test data
      Seed_FnfEligibleEmployee_20261023.sql               test data (a resigning employee for F&F)
      Update_FillerContacts_EmployeesAndUsers_20261022.sql  filler emails / mobiles for test & demo databases only
      Restore_DuplicateTravelFormDocs_20261022.sql        undo for B3 only
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO

-- ===================== SWITCHES: 1 = apply, 0 = preview only =====================
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DeploySwitches') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DeploySwitches;
SELECT CAST(0 AS bit) AS ApplyDuplicateMasterCleanup,   -- B1
       CAST(0 AS bit) AS ApplyCanteenLoginMapping,      -- B2
       CAST(0 AS bit) AS ApplyDeleteDuplicateTravelDocs -- B3
INTO   #DeploySwitches;
-- ==================================================================================
GO
"""

sections = [
 ('A1', 'Mobile attendance tables', 'Migration_MobileAttendance_20261021.sql', None),
 ('A2', 'Salary head CTC Section', 'Migration_SalaryHeadCtcSection_20261023.sql', None),
 ('A3', 'Canteen settings (HR_CMS_Config)', 'Migration_CanteenConfig_20261023.sql', None),
 ('A4', 'Canteen per-meal ordering deadline', 'Migration_CanteenMealSessionOrderCutoff_20261023.sql', None),
 ('A5', 'Canteen meal booking + RBAC', 'Migration_CanteenMealBooking_20261023.sql', None),
 ('A6', 'F&F approval form doc', 'Migration_FnfApprovalFormDoc_20260930.sql', None),
 ('A7', 'F&F exit clearance departments', 'Migration_FnfClearanceDepartmentConfig_20260930.sql', None),
 ('B1', 'Merge duplicate departments / designations', 'Cleanup_DuplicateDepartmentsDesignations_20261023.sql',
    (r"DECLARE @Apply bit = 0;[^\n]*", "DECLARE @Apply bit = (SELECT ApplyDuplicateMasterCleanup FROM #DeploySwitches);   -- switch at the top")),
 ('B2', 'Canteen facility for employees with a login', 'Update_CanteenEmployees_ActiveLoginMapping_20261022.sql',
    (r"DECLARE @Apply\s+BIT\s+= 0;[^\n]*", "DECLARE @Apply              BIT           = (SELECT ApplyCanteenLoginMapping FROM #DeploySwitches);   -- switch at the top")),
 ('B3', 'Remove duplicate Travel form docs', 'Delete_DuplicateTravelFormDocs_20261022.sql',
    (r"DECLARE @Apply BIT = 0;[^\n]*", "DECLARE @Apply BIT = (SELECT ApplyDeleteDuplicateTravelDocs FROM #DeploySwitches);   -- switch at the top")),
]

parts=[header]
for code,title,fname,sub in sections:
    body=open(fname,encoding='utf-8-sig').read().rstrip()
    if sub:
        body,n=re.subn(sub[0],sub[1],body,count=1)
        assert n==1,(fname,sub[0])
    banner=f"=== {code}  {title}  [{fname[:-4]}]"
    parts.append(f"""
-- ##################################################################################################
-- {code}. {title}
--     source: {fname}
-- ##################################################################################################
SET NOEXEC OFF;
GO
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'{banner}';
GO
{body}
GO
-- A section may stop itself with SET NOEXEC ON (missing base tables) - never let that leak into the next one.
SET NOEXEC OFF;
GO
""")
parts.append("""
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'=== Deployment_Since19Oct_20261023 finished. Part B sections only previewed unless their switch was 1.';
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DeploySwitches') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DeploySwitches;
GO
""")
open(out,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(''.join(parts))
EOF
wc -l Deployment_Since19Oct_20261023.sql; grep -n '#DeploySwitches\|^-- [AB][0-9]\.' Deployment_Since19Oct_20261023.sql

    HR_ApprovalInstance.TransactionRecordId needs no FK, same pattern as every prior module - but
    flag this as needing a live sp_help check before anyone assumes these tables are safe to ALTER
    for an unrelated reason later.

    Idempotent - safe to re-run.
*/

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster', 'U') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    DECLARE @heads TABLE (Seq int, HeadName nvarchar(100), HeadDesc nvarchar(510));
    INSERT INTO @heads (Seq, HeadName, HeadDesc) VALUES
        (1, 'GRATUITY',         'Gratuity paid on full and final settlement.'),
        (2, 'LEAVE ENCASHMENT', 'Unused paid-leave balance encashed on full and final settlement.'),
        (3, 'NOTICE PAY',       'Notice pay in lieu, where the company waives the notice period.'),
        (4, 'NOTICE RECOVERY',  'Recovery for notice period not served.'),
        (5, 'ASSET RECOVERY',   'Recovery for company assets not returned or damaged.');

    -- Next free code number, derived from the data. Codes look like SH00000013.
    DECLARE @base int = ISNULL((SELECT MAX(TRY_CONVERT(int, SUBSTRING(Code, 3, 18)))
                                FROM dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster
                                WHERE Code LIKE 'SH%'), 0);

    -- A head keeps ONE code across every company, so the code is allocated per head
    -- name and reused for each company row. An existing head keeps the code it has.
    DECLARE @codes TABLE (HeadName nvarchar(100), HeadCode nvarchar(20), HeadDesc nvarchar(510));
    INSERT INTO @codes (HeadName, HeadCode, HeadDesc)
    SELECT h.HeadName,
           ISNULL((SELECT MIN(s.Code) FROM dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster s WHERE s.Name = h.HeadName),
                  'SH' + RIGHT('00000000' + CAST(@base + h.Seq AS varchar(10)), 8)),
           h.HeadDesc
    FROM   @heads h;

    INSERT INTO dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster
        (Code, Name, Description, Status, AllowInFormula, AllowInPrint, ReportOid, FormID,
         CompanyMasterID, EntryUserMasterID, EntryUserDateTime, SystemName)
    SELECT c.HeadCode, c.HeadName, c.HeadDesc, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0,
           co.companymasterid, 1, GETDATE(), 'migration113'
    FROM   @codes c
    CROSS  JOIN dbo.Company co
    WHERE  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster s
                       WHERE s.Name = c.HeadName
                         AND s.CompanyMasterID = co.companymasterid);

    PRINT '113: seeded F&F salary head rows: ' + CAST(@@ROWCOUNT AS varchar(10));
END
GO

-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  3. Point each company's config at its own heads.
--
--  Only fills a column that is still NULL, so a client who has re-pointed a
--  component at a different head keeps their choice when this re-runs.
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.HR_FNFConfig', 'U') IS NOT NULL
   AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.HR_FNFConfig', 'GratuityHeadID') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE f
    SET    f.GratuityHeadID       = ISNULL(f.GratuityHeadID,       H1.SalaryHeadMasterID),
           f.LeaveEncashHeadID    = ISNULL(f.LeaveEncashHeadID,    H2.SalaryHeadMasterID),
           f.NoticePayHeadID      = ISNULL(f.NoticePayHeadID,      H3.SalaryHeadMasterID),
           f.NoticeRecoveryHeadID = ISNULL(f.NoticeRecoveryHeadID, H4.SalaryHeadMasterID),
           f.AssetRecoveryHeadID  = ISNULL(f.AssetRecoveryHeadID,  H5.SalaryHeadMasterID),
           f.LoanRecoveryHeadID   = ISNULL(f.LoanRecoveryHeadID,   H6.SalaryHeadMasterID)
    FROM   dbo.HR_FNFConfig f
    OUTER  APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 SalaryHeadMasterID FROM dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster
                  WHERE Name = 'GRATUITY'         AND CompanyMasterID = f.CompanyMasterID) H1
    OUTER  APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 SalaryHeadMasterID FROM dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster
                  WHERE Name = 'LEAVE ENCASHMENT' AND CompanyMasterID = f.CompanyMasterID) H2
    OUTER  APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 SalaryHeadMasterID FROM dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster
                  WHERE Name = 'NOTICE PAY'       AND CompanyMasterID = f.CompanyMasterID) H3
    OUTER  APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 SalaryHeadMasterID FROM dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster
                  WHERE Name = 'NOTICE RECOVERY'  AND CompanyMasterID = f.CompanyMasterID) H4
    OUTER  APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 SalaryHeadMasterID FROM dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster
                  WHERE Name = 'ASSET RECOVERY'   AND CompanyMasterID = f.CompanyMasterID) H5
    -- Existing LOAN head, not a new one: a loan settled at exit is the same
    -- deduction the monthly EMI used.
    OUTER  APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 SalaryHeadMasterID FROM dbo.HR_SalaryHeadMaster
                  WHERE Name = 'LOAN'             AND CompanyMasterID = f.CompanyMasterID) H6;

    PRINT '113: pointed HR_FNFConfig at its heads for ' + CAST(@@ROWCOUNT AS varchar(10)) + ' company row(s)';
END
GO

header = r"""/*
    DEPLOYMENT - everything since Deployment_ApprovalAndRecruitment_20261019.sql, plus the complete F&F schema
    Date: 2026-10-23
    Run Deployment_ApprovalAndRecruitment_20261019.sql first (or confirm it already ran). This script carries
    on from it: Mobile Attendance, salary head CTC Section, Canteen meal booking / ordering deadlines / settings,
    everything F&F needs, and today's one-off data fixes.

    HOW TO RUN
        sqlcmd -S <server> -U <user> -d <database> -C -I -i Deployment_Since19Oct_20261023.sql
        (or open it in SSMS and execute). Do NOT pass -b: every section stands alone, and a section that
        stops (e.g. "ABORTED - missing base tables") must not stop the ones after it.
    Run it BEFORE deploying the matching application build, ideally on a copy of the database first,
    then read the Messages tab: every section prints a "=== code ..." banner followed by what it did.

    PART A - schema (always runs; idempotent - each change first checks whether it is already there)
      A1   Mobile attendance tables                                  [Migration_MobileAttendance_20261021]
      A2   HR_SalaryHeadMaster.CTCSection + "CTCSection" lookup list  [Migration_SalaryHeadCtcSection_20261023]
      A3   Canteen settings table HR_CMS_Config                       [Migration_CanteenConfig_20261023]
      A4   Canteen per-meal ordering deadline (+ backfill)            [Migration_CanteenMealSessionOrderCutoff_20261023]
      A5   Canteen meal booking table + RBAC rights                   [Migration_CanteenMealBooking_20261023]
             -> EDIT HERE inside A5: @RoleCodes (default 'ADMIN') = the roles your employees log in with.

      F&F - the whole module's schema, in dependency order. The base tables (F1-F4) are created by the payroll
      app's own migrations (SolutionOneWeb App_Data/DbMigrations 110/111/113/114), which run against the
      payroll database only - an HRMSystem database that never received them has no F&F tables at all and
      every F&F / Exit Formality / Alumni screen fails. They are included verbatim; where the tables already
      exist (a database shared with the payroll app) every step reports "already present" and changes nothing.
      F1 also adds HR_EmployeeMaster.NoticePeriodDays and HR_LeaveMaster.IsEncashable (additive, guarded),
      exactly as the payroll app does.
      F1   HR_FNFSettlement, HR_FNFSettlementDetail, HR_FNFConfig     [SolutionOneWeb 110_CreateFNFSettlement]
      F2   Case workflow: checks, recoveries, alumni, header columns  [SolutionOneWeb 111_FNFCaseWorkflow]
      F3   F&F salary heads per company + HR_FNFConfig head columns   [SolutionOneWeb 113_FNFSalaryHeads]
      F4   HR_ExitFormality, HR_ExitClearance                         [SolutionOneWeb 114_CreateExitFormality]
      F5   F&F approval form doc ("FNF Approval")                     [Migration_FnfApprovalFormDoc_20260930]
      F6   F&F exit clearance departments                             [Migration_FnfClearanceDepartmentConfig_20260930]
      Not included: SolutionOneWeb 112/116/117 - menu rights for the old WebForms sidebar only.
      The F&F code changes of 23 Oct (recovery department drop-down, click-to-edit grids) needed no schema change.

    PART B - one-off data fixes. Each is OFF by default: with its switch at 0 it only PREVIEWS (shows what it
    would change, then rolls back). Read the preview, set the switch to 1 below, run again.
      B1   Merge duplicate departments / designations                 [Cleanup_DuplicateDepartmentsDesignations_20261023]
      B2   Canteen facility + meal plan for employees with a login    [Update_CanteenEmployees_ActiveLoginMapping_20261022]
      B3   Remove the 3 duplicate Travel form docs (dev DB; refuses   [Delete_DuplicateTravelFormDocs_20261022]
           unless exactly those 3 rows qualify)

    NOT INCLUDED - run on their own when needed
      Update_CanteenMealSession_Rates_20261022.sql        needs your Adhoc rates typed in per meal session
      Update_CanteenMealSession_OrderCutoff_20261023.sql  needs your real ordering deadlines per meal session
                                                          (A4 backfills "start time minus 2 hours" meanwhile)
      Seed_MobileAppTestData_20261021.sql                 test data
      Seed_FnfEligibleEmployee_20261023.sql               test data (a resigning employee for F&F)
      Update_FillerContacts_EmployeesAndUsers_20261022.sql  filler emails / mobiles for test & demo databases only
      Restore_DuplicateTravelFormDocs_20261022.sql        undo for B3 only
*/
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO

-- ===================== SWITCHES (Part B): 1 = apply, 0 = preview only =====================
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DeploySwitches') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DeploySwitches;
SELECT CAST(0 AS bit) AS ApplyDuplicateMasterCleanup,   -- B1
       CAST(0 AS bit) AS ApplyCanteenLoginMapping,      -- B2
       CAST(0 AS bit) AS ApplyDeleteDuplicateTravelDocs -- B3
INTO   #DeploySwitches;
-- ===========================================================================================
GO
"""

sections = [
 ('A1', 'Mobile attendance tables', 'Migration_MobileAttendance_20261021.sql', None),
 ('A2', 'Salary head CTC Section', 'Migration_SalaryHeadCtcSection_20261023.sql', None),
 ('A3', 'Canteen settings (HR_CMS_Config)', 'Migration_CanteenConfig_20261023.sql', None),
 ('A4', 'Canteen per-meal ordering deadline', 'Migration_CanteenMealSessionOrderCutoff_20261023.sql', None),
 ('A5', 'Canteen meal booking + RBAC', 'Migration_CanteenMealBooking_20261023.sql', None),
 ('F1', 'F&F settlement tables + config', PAY+'110_CreateFNFSettlement.sql', None),
 ('F2', 'F&F case workflow', PAY+'111_FNFCaseWorkflow.sql', None),
 ('F3', 'F&F salary heads', PAY+'113_FNFSalaryHeads.sql', None),
 ('F4', 'Exit formality tables', PAY+'114_CreateExitFormality.sql', None),
 ('F5', 'F&F approval form doc', 'Migration_FnfApprovalFormDoc_20260930.sql', None),
 ('F6', 'F&F exit clearance departments', 'Migration_FnfClearanceDepartmentConfig_20260930.sql', None),
 ('B1', 'Merge duplicate departments / designations', 'Cleanup_DuplicateDepartmentsDesignations_20261023.sql',
    (r"DECLARE @Apply bit = 0;[^\n]*", "DECLARE @Apply bit = (SELECT ApplyDuplicateMasterCleanup FROM #DeploySwitches);   -- switch at the top")),
 ('B2', 'Canteen facility for employees with a login', 'Update_CanteenEmployees_ActiveLoginMapping_20261022.sql',
    (r"DECLARE @Apply\s+BIT\s+= 0;[^\n]*", "DECLARE @Apply              BIT           = (SELECT ApplyCanteenLoginMapping FROM #DeploySwitches);   -- switch at the top")),
 ('B3', 'Remove duplicate Travel form docs', 'Delete_DuplicateTravelFormDocs_20261022.sql',
    (r"DECLARE @Apply BIT = 0;[^\n]*", "DECLARE @Apply BIT = (SELECT ApplyDeleteDuplicateTravelDocs FROM #DeploySwitches);   -- switch at the top")),
]

parts=[header]
for code,title,path,sub in sections:
    body=open(path,encoding='utf-8-sig').read().rstrip()
    name=path.split('/')[-1]
    src = ('SolutionOneWeb/App_Data/DbMigrations/' + name) if path.startswith(PAY) else name
    if sub:
        body,n=re.subn(sub[0],sub[1],body,count=1)
        assert n==1,(name,sub[0])
    parts.append(f"""
-- ##################################################################################################
-- {code}. {title}
--     source: {src}
-- ##################################################################################################
SET NOEXEC OFF;
GO
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'=== {code}  {title}  [{name[:-4]}]';
GO
{body}
GO
-- A section may stop itself with SET NOEXEC ON (missing base tables) - never let that leak into the next one.
SET NOEXEC OFF;
GO
""")
parts.append("""
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'=== Deployment_Since19Oct_20261023 finished. Part B sections only previewed unless their switch was 1.';
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DeploySwitches') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DeploySwitches;
GO
""")
open(out,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(''.join(parts))
EOF

    PART B - one-off data fixes. Each is OFF by default: with its switch at 0 it only PREVIEWS (shows what it

      B2   Canteen facility + meal plan for employees with a login    [Update_CanteenEmployees_ActiveLoginMapping_20261022]
      B3   Remove the 3 duplicate Travel form docs (dev DB; refuses   [Delete_DuplicateTravelFormDocs_20261022]
           unless exactly those 3 rows qualify)

    NOT INCLUDED - run on their own when needed
      Update_CanteenMealSession_Rates_20261022.sql        needs your Adhoc rates typed in per meal session
      Update_CanteenMealSession_OrderCutoff_20261023.sql  needs your real ordering deadlines per meal session

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DeploySwitches') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DeploySwitches;

INTO   #DeploySwitches;

"""

    (r"DECLARE @Apply bit = 0;[^\n]*", "DECLARE @Apply bit = (SELECT ApplyDuplicateMasterCleanup FROM #DeploySwitches);   -- switch at the top")),

    (r"DECLARE @Apply\s+BIT\s+= 0;[^\n]*", "DECLARE @Apply              BIT           = (SELECT ApplyCanteenLoginMapping FROM #DeploySwitches);   -- switch at the top")),
 ('B3', 'Remove duplicate Travel form docs', 'Delete_DuplicateTravelFormDocs_20261022.sql',

]

-- ##################################################################################################

GO
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'=== {code}  {title}  [{name[:-4]}]';
GO
{body}
GO
-- A section may stop itself with SET NOEXEC ON (missing base tables) - never let that leak into the next one.
SET NOEXEC OFF;
GO
""")
parts.append("""
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'=== Deployment_Since19Oct_20261023 finished. Part B sections only previewed unless their switch was 1.';
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DeploySwitches') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DeploySwitches;
GO
""")

EOF

I've written the consolidated script: `SolutionOne_DataAccessLayer/SqlScripts/Deployment_Since19Oct_20261023.sql`. I haven't run it (no database connection here), so try it on a copy of the database first.

It carries on from `Deployment_ApprovalAndRecruitment_20261019.sql`, so run that one first if it hasn't been run already. Each source script is copied in unchanged, with a "=== code" heading printed before it, so the Messages tab shows what each part did. Every schema section checks before changing anything, so running it twice is safe. Run it without `-b`, so one section that stops doesn't stop the rest.

**Part A – schema changes (always run)**

| | What | Source |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | Mobile attendance tables | `Migration_MobileAttendance_20261021` |
| A2 | Salary head CTC Section | `Migration_SalaryHeadCtcSection_20261023` |
| A3–A5 | Canteen: settings table, per-meal ordering deadline, meal booking + permissions | the three `Migration_Canteen*_20261023` |
| F1–F4 | The core F&F tables: settlement, config, checks, recoveries, alumni, F&F salary heads, exit formality | payroll app migrations 110, 111, 113, 114 |
| F5–F6 | "FNF Approval" form and the F&F clearance departments | the two `Migration_Fnf*_20260930` |

- **A5 needs one edit before you run it:** its "EDIT HERE" block lists the roles allowed to book meals. It defaults to `'ADMIN'`, so add the role your employees log in with.
- **Why F1–F4 are included:** this backend had no script that creates the core F&F tables. They existed only in the payroll app's own migrations, which run against the payroll database. A database that never got those has no F&F tables, and every F&F, Exit Formality and Alumni screen fails.
  - Where the tables already exist, these sections change nothing.
  - F1 also adds two columns to tables shared with the payroll app (`HR_EmployeeMaster.NoticePeriodDays`, `HR_LeaveMaster.IsEncashable`), the same way the payroll migration does.
- **No new schema for today's F&F work:** the recovery department dropdown and the click-to-edit grids needed no database changes.

**Part B – one-off data fixes, preview only by default**

Each one only shows what it would change, then rolls back, until you set its switch to 1 at the top of the file:
- **B1:** merge duplicate departments and designations.
- **B2:** turn on canteen facility and a meal plan for employees who have a login.
- **B3:** remove the three duplicate Travel form docs. This only happens if exactly those three rows match, so on any other database it does nothing.

**Left out, run on their own when needed:**
- `Update_CanteenMealSession_Rates_20261022.sql`: needs your Adhoc rates typed in for each meal session.
- `Update_CanteenMealSession_OrderCutoff_20261023.sql`: needs the real ordering deadlines for each meal session. Until then, A4 sets every deadline to the meal's start time minus 2 hours.
- `Seed_MobileAppTestData`, `Seed_FnfEligibleEmployee` and `Update_FillerContacts`: test and demo data only.
- `Restore_DuplicateTravelFormDocs`: only undoes B3.
- Payroll migrations 112, 116 and 117: they only set menu rights for the old WebForms sidebar.
